column1: # The frozen recall question set (hivemind-y7b6c). DO NOT EDIT ROWS: a build is judged by running this same set,
# so a change to it makes two runs incomparable. A new set is a new file; this one stays.
# Columns (tab separated): id, kind, expect, question, role.
#   id      <standing battery>:<question id>, or dog-<build>:<id> for a question a product check filed.
#   kind    the failure the row watches for. NEARBY: a `why` question answered from a nearby decision instead of the
#           one asked (or a control answered at all), or the decision asked is found but behind others. SYNONYM: the
#           question is in everyday words and the decision is written in other words, so recall never reaches it.
#   expect  the 8-hex prefix of the decision the question is about (`a|b` when two are right), or `none`: nothing in
#           the ledger answers it, so any one-call answer is wrong.
#   role    `fail` = master 45f15984 failed this row on the crew copy or the cell-sized copy when the set was frozen;
#           `guard` = master passed it on both (every tenth such row of the standing batteries, so a fix that breaks
#           a right answer shows up here too).
# A row FAILS when, by kind: NEARBY: `why` answers in one call with a decision other than `expect` (any one-call
# answer for `none`), or `expect` is not in recall's first 3. SYNONYM: `expect` is not in recall's first 3.
# A row whose decision the ledger copy does not hold is left out of that copy's counts.
# Ledger copies it was frozen on (scripts/recall_frozen_set.py --ledger-dir): the crew ledger
# (/home/ubuntu/gc/hivemind/ledger.sqlite, 534 events, 69 decisions) and a copy of the live cell, 165,352 events.
# One row was corrected after the freeze (hivemind-k25y8, mayor ruling on the accepted-first order of hivemind-rgv7a):
# checker:AN1 expects `a42ca00a|19a98974`. a42ca00a, the accepted successor with the same title, is only in the cell
# copy; the crew copy holds 19a98974 alone, so either one answers.
# Five rows were reworded after the freeze (hivemind-4hdwe): checker:L5, checker:AL1, checker:AN1, checker:AP1 and
# tfde:T3 asked about the rename by the new name it was going to get, which the product never took, so the name is out of the
# question; the id, kind, expect and role of each row are as they were. On the 2026-10-21 cell copy (157,563 events) each
# reworded row gets the verdict its old wording got (same flags, same kind of one-call answer). A run made before
